overview: Frontier: Missile Horizon - a decentralized planetary warfare strategy game on ICP where players purchase hex plots of land, accumulate FRNTR tokens, and mine resources in real time.
features: Purchase hex land plots on a 3D globe using ICP
Earn FRNTR tokens passively from owned land
Mine Iron, Fuel, Crystal, and Rare Earth resources in real time
6-tier generator upgrades to boost token production
Live leaderboard ranked by real on-chain FRNTR holdings
Treasury with automated 25/25/50 revenue split on every purchase
Testnet faucet for testing land purchases before mainnet
